title: Slice of Seer au Gratin
description: Prepared with fish, shallot, and grated cheese.

ingredients.name: a nice slice of seer fish
ingredients.sourceText: a nice slice of seer fish

steps: Flatten out on a board a nice slice of seer fish
Prepare a small cupful of maccaroni boiled till tender
Butter a small pie-dish
Sprinkle a dessert-spoonful of minced shallot over the butter
Place a layer of maccaroni on it
Dust over the maccaroni a couple of table-spoonfuls of grated cheese
Put the slice of seer on the top of the maccaroni
Moisten with a breakfast-cupful of broth, in which a little chablis may be mixed
Put a little butter on the fish
Spread a piece of paper over it
Bake for twelve minutes
Remove the paper and serve
Tomatoes, sliced, may be laid on the top of the fish and baked with it if available

title: Slice of Seer en Papillote
description: Prepared with carrot, onion, and salad oil.
steps: Cut a parboiled carrot and one parboiled onion into thin slices
Add powdered dried thyme and marjoram and chopped parsley
Mix this up with three table-spoonfuls of salad oil
Cover your slice of seer with the mixture
Wrap the fish carefully in a sheet of buttered paper
Bake it for half an hour
Remove the paper very carefully and place the slice upon a hot dish
Melt a dessert-spoonful of butter and add a dessert-spoonful of flour
Add a cupful of broth and the vegetables in which the slice was cooked
Boil this for three or four minutes
Strain and pour it over the fish

title: Snipe Pie
description: A pastry dish made with gravy, meat or beef, and beef gravy.

ingredients.name: tender rib-meat or undercut beef
ingredients.sourceText: two pounds of tender rib-meat or undercut beef

ingredients.name: slices of lean bacon, ham, tongue, or Bologna sausage
ingredients.sourceText: slices of lean bacon, ham, tongue, or Bologna sausage

steps: Prepare six snipes as if for roasting for the pie
Sacrifice two snipes for the gravy
Make a good beef gravy
Throw the two snipes into the gravy and simmer slowly
Make a puree by pounding the meat of the birds to a paste and blending it with the gravy
Rub the pie-dish with a shallot
Fill the bottom of the pie-dish with little collops of tender beef rolled with strips of bacon
Dust spiced pepper over each layer until all beef is used
Lay the six snipes on the surface of the beef with slices of lean bacon, ham, tongue, or Bologna sausage between each bird
Garnish as usual
Baptize the pie with the puree, saving some for the final process
Cover with a nice light paste and bake

title: Sole Fillets with Poor Man's Sauce
description: A sauce made with sauce, soles, and shallot.

ingredients.name: broth made from sole bones and trimmings
ingredients.sourceText: broth made from sole bones and trimmings

ingredients.name: a spoonful of chablis or sauterne
ingredients.sourceText: a spoonful of chablis or sauterne

ingredients.name: a couple of finely minced onions
ingredients.sourceText: a couple of finely minced onions

ingredients.name: a coffee-cupful of the gravy in which the fillets were cooked
ingredients.sourceText: a coffee-cupful of the gravy in which the fillets were cooked

steps: Fillet a couple of nice soles
Brush the fillets over on one side with egg
Dust over that some minced parsley and shallot
Roll up your fillets, securing each in shape with a tiny skewer
Simmer these fillets carefully in a broth made from their own bones and trimmings, assisted by a spoonful of chablis or sauterne, and a coffee-cupful of stock
When done, place the fillets on a hot dish and cover them up
For the sauce: Fry a couple of finely minced onions in butter till they assume a golden tint
Stir into this, by degrees, a coffee-cupful of the gravy in which the fillets were cooked
When boiling, sharpen this by adding a spoonful of vinegar
Strain and pour it into another sauce-pan by degrees in which some good sauce blanche has been made
Mix thoroughly over the fire, and serve round the fillets

title: Souffle de Volaille
description: Prepared with meat, ham, and white sauce.

ingredients.name: the nicest meat of a full sized cold roast chicken
ingredients.sourceText: the nicest meat of a full sized cold roast chicken

ingredients.sourceText: broth made of the bones and trimmings

steps: Mince the chicken meat very finely
Put it in a frying-pan with {{source-1}} and minced ham
Toss till the butter is absorbed
Make about half a pint of rich white sauce flavoured with almonds, pepper, salt, and broth from the bones
Throw the mince into a mortar and pound to a paste, moistening with the sauce

Add last the whites of the eggs whipped to a stiff froth

title: Soup Royal
description: A soup made with beef, calf's head, and tongue.

ingredients.name: roasted and ground split peas or gram dal
ingredients.sourceText: roasted and ground split peas or gram dal

steps: Take a shin of beef, the best parts of meat cut off from a calf's head, and the tongue
Cut the beef into small particles, but leave the tongue and the meat from the calf's head whole
Add pepper and salt and boil well, clearing the scum as it rises
Remove the tongue and the meat of the calf's head when sufficiently tender
Continue to boil the shin of beef until it is well dissolved
Strain it and cut away all the fat
Put it up again with plenty of soup herbs and more salt and pepper if necessary
Boil it well up
Squeeze into the soup the juice of half a lemon and skim it well
Strain it once more and set it aside
Cut the tongue into slices of an eighth of an inch thick
Trim them into the shape of large diamonds and set aside
Cut up the meat of the calf's head into one-inch squares and strips of an inch and a half long and half an inch wide
Add to these a few ready-fried circular flat brain cakes
Make also a few egg balls and forcemeat balls, and after cooking, add them to the rest of the meat, tongue, etc., and set aside

Take four red carrots, one pound of green peas, half a pound of boiled potatoes, one large turnip, one large Patna onion, a quarter of a pound of roasted and ground split peas or gram dal, some soup herbs, pepper, and salt, the pulp of one orange, and the peels of half an orange and half a lemon
Put these into a stewpan with water sufficient to cover the whole
Boil them thoroughly, skimming all the while
When perfectly dissolved, turn them out into a colander and allow all the water to drain away
Turn the contents of the colander into a sieve and pass the vegetables, etc., through it, rejecting all such as will not pass
Add the whole or a part of the strained vegetables to the soup, which should not be thicker in consistency than a good thick potato soup
Stew one dozen good French prunes in a claret-glassful of port wine
Strain through a sieve, rejecting stones, etc., and add the strained portion to the soup
Boil the whole and strain it once more
Add to it all the forcemeat and egg balls, the brain cakes, tongue, etc., and serve up, adding to it more salt, wine, or sauce, if needed

title: Sour Meat
description: Prepared with meat, tamarind, and onion.

ingredients.name: 1 chhatak of ripe tamarind without seeds
ingredients.sourceText: 1 chhatak of ripe tamarind without seeds

ingredients.name: 1/2 seer of small pieces of meat
ingredients.sourceText: 1/2 seer of small pieces of meat

steps: Keep 1 chhatak of ripe tamarind without seeds immersed in 1 powa of water for about 15 minutes
Squeeze them in the water and throw away the refuse
Mix salt, powdered turmeric, ginger-juice, onion-juice, a little powdered pepper and mustard oil with 1/2 seer of small pieces of meat
Fry broken chillies and cassia leaves in enough ghee
Fry the meat in it for about 15 minutes
Add about 1/2 seer of water and when this water nearly dries up add the tamarind solution
Add browned pieces of vegetables if desired
Add sugar as desired about 5 minutes before taking down
Keep as thick soup

title: Souvarienne
description: Prepared with cake, chocolate, and cream.

ingredients.name: an ounce of finely sifted sugar
ingredients.sourceText: an ounce of finely sifted sugar

ingredients.name: half an ounce of dissolved gelatine
ingredients.sourceText: half an ounce of dissolved gelatine

ingredients.name: chopped pistachio nuts, almonds, sugar plums or crystallized sugar
ingredients.sourceText: chopped pistachio nuts, almonds, sugar plums or crystallized sugar

steps: Cut the slices of cake the length of the depth of the mould, the eighth of an inch thick, and an inch and a half wide.
Cut a circular piece the size of the bottom of the mould.
Make a cement with the whites of three eggs, and an ounce of finely sifted sugar.
Arrange the slices round the side of the mould slightly overlapping one another, and cement them firmly together, fixing their ends to the circular top placed at the bottom of the mould.
When the cement dries, the case will be quite firm.
Choose a mould for the ice slightly smaller than this case, so that the latter may cover it nicely.
When firmly set, the cake case may be turned out upon a dish.
Brush its outside over with some thin cement, and sprinkle over with chopped pistachio nuts, almonds, sugar plums or crystallized sugar.
For the ice: Dissolve {{source-3}} in a pint of boiling milk, when quite smooth, and cold, add half a pint of cream, a tea-spoonful of vanilla essence and the yolks of ten eggs.
Make a custard of the mixture adding {{source-8}}.
Stir in half an ounce of dissolved gelatine while the custard is warm.
Whip it briskly and put it into the freezer.
Freeze, mixing into the half-frozen custard a coffee-cupful of whipped cream.
Turn it out when ready, cover with the case, and serve.

title: Spiced Beef
description: Prepared with brisket, rind, and madeira.

ingredients.name: nice brisket or fleshy piece of the flank
ingredients.sourceText: nice brisket or fleshy piece of the flank

ingredients.name: half an ounce of pepper corns (ground)
ingredients.sourceText: half an ounce of pepper corns (ground)

ingredients.name: a tablespoonful of finely minced parsley
ingredients.sourceText: a tablespoonful of finely minced parsley

ingredients.name: chopped rind of a nice yellow lime, peeled very finely
ingredients.sourceText: chopped rind of a nice yellow lime, peeled very finely

ingredients.name: a couple of glasses of Madeira
ingredients.sourceText: a couple of glasses of Madeira

steps: Remove all bones.
Rub the joint well with salt, and let it lie in the brine for about two days.
Spread it out flat and dry it.
Lay a coating of the spices over the inside in the same manner as you would spread jam over paste before making a rolypoly pudding.
Roll up the brisket and tie it tightly with a string.
Stew it patiently until tender.
Set it under a weight when done.
When cold, remove the string and trim the joint neatly.
Glaze it, and when the glaze is dry, the beef may be considered ready for the table.

title: Spinach
description: Prepared with spinach, milk or gravy or stock, and milk or stock.

ingredients.name: three quarters of an ounce of flour
ingredients.sourceText: three quarters of an ounce of flour

ingredients.name: a coffee-cupful of milk, gravy, or stock
ingredients.sourceText: a coffee-cupful of milk, gravy, or stock

ingredients.name: a breakfast-cupful of milk or stock

ingredients.name: butter or cream or the yolk of an egg dissolved in a little milk
ingredients.sourceText: butter or cream or the yolk of an egg dissolved in a little milk

steps: Having selected two pounds of leaves carefully, wash them well
Blanch them by plunging them for a couple of minutes in scalding water
Drain and chop them up
Put into a stew-pan {{source-1}}, three quarters of an ounce of flour, a pinch of salt, and one of sugar
Stir this over the fire for three minutes
Add the spinach leaves
Stir round for five minutes
Moisten with a coffee-cupful of milk, gravy, or stock
Stir for two minutes more
Add a breakfast-cupful of the milk or stock
Stir for five minutes and take the pan from the fire
Mingle a little butter with the spinach, or give it a spoonful of cream, or the yolk of an egg dissolved in a little milk
Turn it out upon a good hot dish
Garnish it with sippets of fried bread, fleurons of puff pastry, or short-bread biscuits specially baked for the dish
Serve

Mingle a little butter with the spinach, or give it a spoonful of cream, or the yolk of an egg dissolved in a little milk

title: Standard Fritter Batter
description: Prepared with brandy, salad oil, and eggs.

ingredients.name: one table-spoonful of the best salad oil
ingredients.sourceText: one table-spoonful of the best salad oil

ingredients.name: four or five table-spoonfuls of cold water
ingredients.sourceText: four or five table-spoonfuls of cold water

steps: Beat up the yolks of three eggs with two table-spoonfuls of brandy, one table-spoonful of the best salad oil, and four or five table-spoonfuls of cold water.
Incorporate with this mixture three table-spoonfuls of flour and a salt-spoonful of salt.
Work this, with care, to a smooth paste, and continue to beat it for at least ten minutes.
If the batter appear too thick, add a little water until its consistency be satisfactory, i.e.: it should cover the spoon when lifted out of it with a coating about the eighth of an inch thick.
Take the whites of the three eggs, and whip them to a stiff froth.
Stir this into your batter at the time of using.

title: Stewed Eels
description: Prepared with eels, onion, and claret.
steps: Skin a couple of eels, clean, parboil, and divide them into two inch fillets for stewing
Put into your stew-pan {{source-1}}, with a Bombay onion sliced
Stir over the fire for five minutes
Add half a pint of claret, and half a pint of stock, with a clove of garlic, a carrot cut up, and a bag of sweet herbs
Boil this for ten minutes, stirring it well with your wooden spoon
Throw in a salt-spoonful of salt, a tea-spoonful of spiced pepper, the rind of a lime, and place the pieces of eel in the midst
Simmer this for half an hour
Arrange the pieces of the fish upon the hot dish, strain the gravy rapidly, thicken it
Re-heat it almost to boiling point, add a pinch of sugar, and a table-spoonful of chopped parsley
Pour it round the fish

title: Stuffed Eggs with Jerusalem Artichokes
description: Prepared with eggs, jerusalem artichokes, and melted butter.

ingredients.name: maitre d'hotel butter or prawn butter
ingredients.sourceText: maitre d'hotel butter or prawn butter

steps: Boil four eggs hard and put them into a basin of cold water
When cold, cut them in halves crosswise with a dessert-knife dipped in melted butter
Slice off a piece from each rounded end so that the halves will sit upright
Prepare the yolks as previously described
Boil four large Jerusalem artichokes until just done and not overdone
Lift them out of the water and let them get cold
Trim with a silver dessert-knife two thick flat slices from each artichoke, each capable of holding a half egg
Butter the eight slices and lay them upon a flat silver dish well buttered
Set half an egg upon each of them
Put on the top of each egg a little pat of anchovy butter
Set the dish in the oven till the steam rises freely and serve piping hot
If desired, pour melted maitre d'hotel or prawn butter over them

title: Sulphur Pastiles For Meat Preservation
description: Prepared with saltpetre and water.

ingredients.name: one and a half parts powdered charcoal
ingredients.sourceText: one and a half parts powdered charcoal

steps: Mix the sulphur, charcoal, and saltpetre together
Add just enough gum water to make pastiles
Shape them like pyramids
Dry them in the sun
Suspend the meat in an air-tight box furnished with hooks, a closely fitting door, and all crevices filled with putty and pasted over with strips of strong paper
Place two or three pastiles below the meat
Light the pastiles
Close the door securely and leave for two or three hours
The meat will keep perfectly for thirty-six hours and be found deliciously tender

title: The Savoury Omelette
description: Prepared with fowl, shallot, and cream.

ingredients.name: tea-spoonful of very finely minced shallot
ingredients.sourceText: tea-spoonful of very finely minced shallot

ingredients.name: heaped up table-spoonful of minced curly parsley
ingredients.sourceText: heaped up table-spoonful of minced curly parsley

steps: Break four ordinary country fowl's eggs whole into a slop-basin, and add the yolks only of two more eggs
Thoroughly mix the six yolks and four whites by using two forks, without beating them at all
Flavour the mixture with a salt-spoonful of salt, a tea-spoonful of very finely minced shallot, a heaped up table-spoonful of minced curly parsley, and a table-spoonful of really rich cream
Stir this for a minute

Melt a pat of butter in a shallow pan about ten inches in diameter over a good charcoal fire, sufficient in quantity to thoroughly lubricate the whole surface and leave a coating of moisture about an eighth of an inch deep
When the butter is quite burning hot, having ceased to splutter and beginning to brown, pour in the mixture with one good stir round
At the moment of contact, lift the underpart of omelette formed with a spoon, and allow the unformed portion to run beneath it, while holding and playing the pan from side to side with the left hand
With one good shake, lift the pan from the fire in less than a minute and roll its contents into a hot silver dish that has been prepared with a little melted butter, minced parsley, and shallot

title: To Clarify Sugar
description: Prepared with sugar, white of egg, and water.

ingredients.name: 1 pint and a half of water
ingredients.sourceText: 1 pint and a half of water

steps: To every three pounds of loaf sugar allow the beaten white of one egg and a pint and a half of water
Break the sugar small and put it into a nicely cleaned brass pan
Pour the water over it and let it stand some time before it be put upon the fire
Add the beaten white of the egg and stir till the sugar be entirely dissolved
When it boils up pour in a quarter of a pint of cold water
Let it boil up a second time
Remove it from the fire and let it settle for fifteen minutes
Carefully take off all the scum
Put it again on the fire and boil till sufficiently thick or till candy high
To ascertain this, drop a little from a spoon into a cup of cold water, and if it become quite hard it is ready

ingredients.name: a quarter of a pound of brown sugar

steps: Cut a hind quarter of good mutton into the shape of a ham

Rub the ham well with this mixture, taking care to stuff the hole of the shank well with salt and sugar, and let it lie a fortnight, rubbing it well with the pickle every two or three days

Smoke it with sawdust for ten or fifteen days, or hang it to dry in the kitchen

title: Trimmed Globe Artichokes Beignets
description: Prepared with artichoke, lime or vinegar, and vinegar.
steps: Place the raw artichoke bottom downwards on a board, and cut it straight down, dividing it in half
Divide each half so obtained so that you have four quarters
Pare out the choke which adheres to each quarter, as you would core an apple
Trim off the leaves leaving about an eighth of an inch of them unsevered and adhering to the trimmed quarters

title: Turban of Snipes
description: Prepared with snipe, beef gravy, and onion.

ingredients.name: a lightly roasted chicken with its liver
ingredients.sourceText: a lightly roasted chicken with its liver

ingredients.name: a dessert-spoonful of vinegar or lime juice
ingredients.sourceText: a dessert-spoonful of vinegar or lime juice

ingredients.name: a dessert-spoonful of red currant jelly
ingredients.sourceText: a dessert-spoonful of red currant jelly

ingredients.name: a tin of black Leicestershire mushrooms
ingredients.sourceText: a tin of black Leicestershire mushrooms

steps: Roast the snipes lightly, then cut off the meat of the breasts whole in fillets

Mash the rest, trails and all, and throw the debris into a large sauce-pan with a pint and a half of well made beef gravy, an onion cut up, a stick of celery, a carrot, sweet herbs in a bag, a clove of garlic, salt to taste, a tea-spoonful of sugar, and the peel of a lime
Simmer for an hour or more to get the essence out of the snipe bones
When done, strain off your gravy, and set it to get cool
Pick all the snipe meat from the bones of the thighs and back, with the livers, &c, and pound the whole with half its bulk of bread (soaked in stock) in a mortar
Add the pounded meat of a lightly roasted chicken with its liver, and mix them thoroughly with two raw eggs
Season the mixture with spiced pepper, and dilute it with some of the gravy
When worked sufficiently, put it into a border mould, and steam it gently
For the gravy: place a sauce-pan on the fire, with a table-spoonful of butter at the bottom of it
Work into the melted butter a dessert-spoonful of flour, and then add your cool gravy, stirring all the time
Pour in a glass of portwine, a dessert-spoonful of vinegar or lime juice, and a dessert-spoonful of red currant jelly
Amalgamate the whole thoroughly, heat up the fillets and heads in it, and the mushrooms strained from their own gravy
Turn the turban out when done, garnish the top with the snipe heads and beaks, and with a fillet (heated separately in the gravy) between each head
Put the mushrooms inside the mould, pour the gravy over the whole composition, and serve piping hot

title: Turkish Coffee
description: Prepared with coffee and water.
steps: Roast the berries with care
Cast the berries into a large metal mortar and pound them to a very fine powder
Carefully sift the powder through a fine sieve, rejecting all coarse particles
Boil the required amount of water in a small copper can with a narrow top and broad bottom
When the water boils, add powdered coffee according to requirements and replace the can on the fire
Permit the liquid to come to the boil three times, taking the can off the fire for a while after each boiling
After the third boiling, place the can for a minute in a shallow vessel containing cold water to precipitate the grounds
Pour the clear, black, and sparkling coffee into the cup

title: Vanilla Souffle
description: Prepared with vanilla, powdered sugar, and liqueur.

ingredients.name: a small piece of fresh butter
ingredients.sourceText: a small piece of fresh butter

ingredients.name: half a pint of new milk

ingredients.name: a few drops of vanilla flavoring
ingredients.sourceText: a few drops of vanilla flavoring

steps: Mix together in a sauce-pan one table-spoonful of flour, a small piece of fresh butter, half a pint of new milk, and a dessert-spoonful of powdered sugar
Stir this over the fire to get thoroughly warm but no more
Put it on one side to get cool, stirring to prevent any scum forming on the surface
When quite cold, stir into it the yolks of four eggs
Add a few drops of vanilla flavoring
Mix this thoroughly
Throw in a table-spoonful of any liqueur you may have open
Add the whites of six eggs whipped to a froth
Mix the whole together
Pour it into a souffle tin
Bake in an oven at moderate heat
Serve the moment your eye tells you that the souffle is ready

title: Vol-Au-Vent Case
description: Prepared with puff-paste, butter, and egg.
steps: Make very carefully a pound of puff-paste, following the directions given at page 263
Give the paste six turns, and roll it out three-quarters of an inch thick
Cut out of this as neatly as possible an oval piece the size you wish your vol-au-vent to be
Turn it over upon a buttered baking-sheet
Brush the surface and side with a beaten egg, and mark out the interior oval, leaving an inch margin all round
Let the knife cut this tracing to a depth of a quarter of an inch
Put the sheet in the oven, and when the paste is baked, remove the inner oval (for a cover) which you will find has risen
Scoop out the uncooked paste inside the case
Brush the whole case thus formed with egg again, and bake it for about five minutes

Bake for ten minutes in a really hot oven, then remove the paper and serve.

title: Woodcock Toast
description: Prepared with fowl, anchovy or sauce or fish, and bread.

ingredients.name: tea-spoonful of anchovy sauce or flesh of one fish pounded
ingredients.sourceText: tea-spoonful of anchovy sauce or flesh of one fish pounded

steps: Pound the liver to a paste, mixing with it a tea-spoonful of anchovy sauce or the flesh of one fish pounded
Add a pinch of sugar, plenty of fresh butter, and the yolk of one raw egg
Dust into it a little spiced pepper
Pass it through the sieve and set it aside on a clean plate
Prepare four squares of golden-tinted, crisply-fried bread, about half an inch thick
Spread the liver paste over them and set them in a moderate oven to retain their heat, but not to burn
Pour a coffee-cupful of good cream into a sauce-pan, which must either be dipped into a bain-marie, or placed over a very low fire
Stir into it, as it warms, the carefully strained yolks of two raw eggs
Continue stirring one way till the cream thickens nicely and is quite hot without boiling
Pour it over your toasts
The egg whites should be whisked to a stiff froth and laid on the top of all
Send the dish up without delay

title: Amati Tamana (Sweet and Sour Cabbage)
description: Prepared with cabbage, vinegar, and lemon or orange peel.
steps: Cut a small, hard cabbage very fine.
Place in frying pan one tablespoonful of goma oil, and when it is boiling hot throw in the shredded cabbage.
Sprinkle with salt, and fry, stirring constantly to keep it from burning.
Add one tablespoonful of sugar, the same quantity of vinegar, and a little piece of lemon or orange peel, shaved very fine.
Cover tight, and let all simmer for twenty minutes.
Finally add half a teaspoon of goma seeds.
Serve hot.

title: Apple Jelly, Japanese Style
description: Prepared with jelly, apples, and starch.

ingredients.name: one half pound of seaweed jelly
ingredients.sourceText: one half pound of seaweed jelly

steps: After washing half a pound of seaweed jelly soak it in water for about three hours, then squeeze it dry and break in small pieces into a pan with one and a half quarts of water.
Boil over medium heat.
Add three quarters of a pound of sugar, stirring the while, and a pinch of salt.
Prepare two big, tart apples by peeling and removing the cores, then rub them on a nutmeg grater until they are reduced to powder.
Transfer jelly to another saucepan, strain it, and mix with powdered apple.
When thoroughly boiled, add two tablespoonfuls of kudzu starch, dissolved in cold water.
Stir well with wooden chopsticks or spoon.
Remove from fire, and pour into lacquered box or molds.
Two or three hours after it has hardened, cut in desired shapes and sizes.

title: Char Qua (Chinese Artichokes)
description: Prepared with olive oil, eggs, and salt.

ingredients.name: one tablespoonful of Quong Sang Chong
ingredients.sourceText: one tablespoonful of Quong Sang Chong

steps: First wash thoroughly in cold water, then turn them into boiling salted water and boil about twenty minutes.

Meanwhile prepare the following sauce: Mix one teaspoonful of olive oil with one tablespoonful of Quong Sang Chong (water chestnut flour) until very smooth, then pour enough boiling water over it to make a thick cream.
Add one teaspoonful of syou, and let it just come to a boil, stirring in the chopped parsley gently.
Arrange the artichokes on a small platter with green lining, or place a green leaf under each artichoke.
Fill the center of each with the yolks of hard-boiled egg, whipped smooth with a little olive oil and salt.
Lastly, pour the sauce over, and serve.
This should look like a water lily.

Roll in powdered sugar.

title: Dai-Kan (Orange Jelly Candy)
description: A confection made with jelly, white sugar, and starch.

ingredients.name: one half pound of Kanton (seaweed jelly)
ingredients.sourceText: one half pound of Kanton (seaweed jelly)

ingredients.name: three quarters pound of fine white sugar
ingredients.sourceText: three quarters pound of fine white sugar

steps: Wash half a pound of dry seaweed jelly, and soak it for two and a half hours in cold water.
Then squeeze out all the water and break in small pieces.
Boil in about a quart of water, until well melted, then mix three quarters of a pound of sugar with this, stirring with chopsticks or wooden spoon.
Strain into another pan, and boil over medium fire.
Take three tablespoonfuls of kudzu starch and dissolve in a little cold water.
Then, drop by drop, gradually drop this into the jelly, while stirring with wooden spoon.
When it becomes transparent, squeeze in the juice of two oranges and immediately remove from fire.
Pour into a wooden box, and set in cool place for two hours to harden.

title: Duck Chop Suey
description: Prepared with duck, duck fat, and mushrooms.

ingredients.name: Three or three and one half pound duck
ingredients.sourceText: Three or three and one half pound duck

ingredients.name: One and one quarter tablespoonfuls of syou
ingredients.sourceText: One and one quarter tablespoonfuls of syou

ingredients.name: One half cup of small white onions
ingredients.sourceText: One half cup of small white onions

steps: Carefully wash the duck and remove the bones, then wipe dry and pound the meat until tender.
Chop up about a tablespoonful of duck fat, and fry.
Remove all lumps of fat, leaving only the clear oil, and put in the duck meat, cut in small pieces.
Fry to a golden brown.
Add one and one half tablespoonfuls of syou, a dash of cayenne pepper, and half a tablespoonful of salt.

Cover, and let simmer for twenty minutes while preparing the following: Wash and soak for ten minutes {{source-5}}, pulling off all stalks and cutting small; cut up a bunch of celery small, and add a cupful of small white onions.
Slice a dozen lotus seeds very thin, and half a can of bamboo shoots.
Put all in with the duck and fry ten minutes; then add {{source-10}} and cook five minutes longer.
Serve with rice.

title: Duck With Herbs
description: Prepared with duck, pork fat, and onion.

ingredients.name: One quarter pound of pork fat
ingredients.sourceText: One quarter pound of pork fat

steps: Drain and singe the duck.
Wipe, then thoroughly dry, inside and out, with a clean, damp cloth.
Line a pan with small pieces of pork (fat).
Sprinkle the bottom with minced onion, celery, grated lemon peel, and the garlic, grated fine.
Lay the duck in and cover with a tablespoonful of mixed spices, two tablespoonfuls of syou, and a cup of rich stock.
Set over the fire and simmer for two hours, basting often.
Wash the mushrooms and turn them in, and cook all together for ten minutes.
Take up, and thicken the gravy with cornstarch or rice flour.
Lastly, toss in the chopped parsley.
Cut up the duck in small pieces (not too small), arrange on dish, pour the gravy with the herbs around the duck, and serve hot with rice.

description: A soup made with chicken stock, chicken, and ham.

Serve with rice.

steps: Take one and one half cupfuls of rice flour and a pinch of salt and into this work three teaspoonfuls of clarified goose fat.

Beat the yolks of two eggs, and mix all together.
Now pour in one cup of raw, dark honey.

Stir thoroughly for fifteen or twenty minutes, and pour into small cake pans, well oiled, and bake slowly for two hours.

description: Prepared with pigeons, sauce, and sauce or sherry.

steps: Select good, plump pigeons, and singe and clean thoroughly, then dry.
Rub well with salt.
Take the fat pork and fry out all the fat, and when boiling hot put in the pigeons and brown all over, rolling them on all sides.
Have ready the water chestnuts, washed and cut in thin slices, also the bamboo shoots cut in thin strips.
Chop up the onion very fine, and turn into the saucepan with the pigeons, adding the syou sauce, pepper, salt, and sugar.
Cover very tight, and simmer over a slow fire for one hour.
Then add the mirin sauce, or sherry.
Mix two tablespoonfuls of kudzu starch in cold water, and stir into the juice until it thickens.
Serve with rice.

title: Karefish Nigore (Sole Jelly)
description: Prepared with sole, jelly, and sauce.

ingredients.name: one half pound Kanton (dried seaweed jelly)
ingredients.sourceText: one half pound Kanton (dried seaweed jelly)

steps: First prepare the sole by cutting away the head and thoroughly cleaning and scaling.
Cut in fillets or slices, removing the small bones.
Take one cupful of mirin sauce and a pinch of salt.
Place in pot, and boil only a few minutes.
Chop into small pieces two carrots and about a quarter pound of dried mushrooms (first washed and soaked).
Boil in a small quantity of water, and when tender, strain.
Add the mirin sauce, previously boiled for fifteen minutes.
Wash half a pound of dry seaweed jelly, and soak in water for two hours.
Take out, and squeeze dry.
Break in small pieces, and throw in pan with a quart of water.
Boil and dissolve.
Strain into another saucepan.
Add half a cupful of sugar and a tablespoonful of syou sauce.
With this mix the fish and vegetables, and stir thoroughly.
Transfer to lacquered or smooth wooden box, and let it set.
When it is firm, cut in desired small shapes.

title: Kuwai-Kinton (Water Chestnut Cream)
description: Prepared with water, sweet potatoes, and vinegar.

ingredients.name: three quarters pound of sweet potatoes
ingredients.sourceText: three quarters pound of sweet potatoes

ingredients.name: one half pint of mirin sauce
ingredients.sourceText: one half pint of mirin sauce

steps: Peel the skin from fifteen large water chestnuts and slice them very thin
Boil in lukewarm water for about fifteen minutes
Peel the sweet potatoes, cut in slices, and dip in ice-cold water three or four times, changing the water with each dipping
Boil about one quart in an enameled saucepan, add the vinegar, then throw in the sweet potatoes
Cover, and boil for about twenty minutes
If tender, drain off all the water and add the sugar, with five tablespoonfuls of warm water and also the mirin sauce
Add a pinch of salt
Place over the fire and add the above prepared water chestnuts
When the water chestnuts have thoroughly absorbed the juice, add the strained sweet potatoes, stir with wooden spoon, taking care not to burn it, and boil until it is firm
Serve hot or cold

title: Lai Yut (Beautiful Moon Tarts)
description: A pastry dish made with rice flour, goose fat, and ice.

ingredients.name: one heaping tablespoonful of clarified goose fat
ingredients.sourceText: one heaping tablespoonful of clarified goose fat

ingredients.name: lychee nuts, stoned and mashed to a pulp
ingredients.sourceText: two cups of lychee nuts, stoned and mashed to a pulp

ingredients.name: one and one half cupfuls of sugar
ingredients.sourceText: one and one half cupfuls of sugar

ingredients.name: quarter of a cupful of crystallized limes
ingredients.sourceText: quarter of a cupful of crystallized limes

ingredients.name: candied orange peel or fruit coloring
ingredients.sourceText: candied orange peel or fruit coloring

steps: Work a heaping tablespoonful of clarified goose fat into two cups of rice flour.
Add ice-cold water slowly to make a stiff paste.
Roll out, brush with the whipped whites of eggs, and fold over several times, each time brushing with egg.
Roll about quarter of an inch thick and cut into rounds about the size of a small saucer.
Put in the filling, and place another round of paste on top.
Press together at the edge, forming a rounded edge, and brush all again with white of egg.
Bake for fifty minutes in a moderate oven, then remove the outer flake, which will leave the tart snow white.
Decorate with a yellow moon in the center, cut from candied orange peel or painted with fruit coloring.

title: Lobster Chow Main
description: Prepared with lobster, noodles, and celery.
steps: First boil the peanut oil and into it throw the noodles, cooking until crisp.
Remove and drain, while preparing following:
Put teaspoon of sweet lard into frying pan, and when hot turn in half the lobster meat, which has previously been cooked.

Take a hot platter, and place the crisp noodles as a layer at the bottom of the dish, and spread above ingredients on top.
Then take the other half of the lobster meat, and place a layer on top.
Garnish with shredded yolks of hard-boiled eggs.

title: Lychee Chicken
description: Prepared with chicken, nuts, and onion.
steps: Cut into small pieces a fresh young chicken of about two pounds and rub well with salt.
Fry two tablespoonfuls of sweet lard a very light brown.
Add two tablespoonfuls of syou, and cover tight.
Simmer for half an hour.
Have ready a quart of lychee nuts, peeled and stoned.
Add these to the chicken, with the minced onion, and cook slowly for twenty-six minutes.
Serve with rice.

title: Meat Chow Main
description: Prepared with noodles, peanut, and pork.

ingredients.name: one half pound of dried mushrooms
ingredients.sourceText: one half pound of dried mushrooms

steps: Into a quart of peanut oil put a quarter of a pound of noodles, and cook until crisp; then remove and drain.
Meanwhile take one pound of pork, cut it in small pieces, and fry a golden brown.
Cut up half a pound of veal, and fry with the pork for five minutes.
Add two tablespoonfuls of syou and half a tablespoonful of salt to this, and let it simmer slowly, while preparing the following:

Wash, and soak for ten minutes, half a pound of Chinese dried mushrooms, pulling off the stalks; half a bunch of celery, cut small; also one onion, chopped fine, and half a dozen water chestnuts, sliced fine.
Turn these in with the meat and cook all together for five minutes.
Place the noodles on a hot platter as a bottom layer, then the meat and vegetables.
Garnish the top with threaded ham and the crumbled yolks of two hard-boiled eggs.

title: Mo Ku Gai T'ong (Spring Chicken Soup with Mushrooms)
description: A soup made with chicken, mushrooms, and pork.

ingredients.name: two and one half pounds of chicken
ingredients.sourceText: two and one half pounds of chicken

ingredients.name: one quarter pound of lean pork
ingredients.sourceText: one quarter pound of lean pork

ingredients.name: one quarter pound of dried mushrooms
ingredients.sourceText: one quarter pound of dried mushrooms

steps: Clean a fresh young chicken of about two and one half pounds
Cut off all the flesh; put the bones, with liver and gizzard, into three pints of cold water, and boil for two hours, adding water if it boils away
While the stock is boiling, cut up the chicken meat into small pieces
Cut up very fine one quarter pound of lean pork
Wash and soak in lukewarm water one quarter pound of dried mushrooms
Pull off all the stalks
Peel and cut a dozen lotus seeds or water chestnuts
Chop three stalks of celery very fine, and also one onion
Pour off the liquor from the bones, and strain
Cut up liver and gizzard fine and return to stock
Add all the ingredients, with one teaspoonful of salt and one tablespoonful of syou
Boil all together for one hour

title: Mushi Ahiru (Baked Duck)
description: Prepared with duck, starch, and giblets.
steps: Clean and singe the duck and wash in lukewarm water, then wipe dry with a clean cloth.
Rub well with salt.
Cut in pieces, and dip each piece of the duck in a batter made of kudzu starch and eggs.
Make the batter of about the thickness of fritters.
Lay these in a pan that has been oiled, and bake in a slow oven for two hours.
Make a gravy by chopping the giblets very fine and putting them in a pot with a cupful of water, a cupful of syou sauce, salt and pepper, and a teaspoonful of sugar.
Boil slowly while the duck is baking.
Place the duck, which should be well browned, on a platter, then pour over it the gravy and garnish with orange or lemon peel, grated.

title: Mushi Kiji (Roast Pheasant)
description: Prepared with pheasant, almonds, and rice.

ingredients.name: small Japanese almonds
ingredients.sourceText: one pound of small Japanese almonds

ingredients.name: one and one half cupfuls of rice paste
ingredients.sourceText: one and one half cupfuls of rice paste

ingredients.name: one half cupful of cooking sauce
ingredients.sourceText: one half cupful of cooking sauce

steps: Wash and singe the bird, then rub well with salt.
Place in deep dish and cover with three cupfuls of mirin sauce; more, if that quantity does not cover the bird.
Lay away in a cool place over night, then drain off all liquid.
Have ready the almonds, blanched and chopped very fine.
Add them to the rice paste with the sugar, a little salt, quarter of a cup of cooking sauce, and a pinch of mixed spices.
Stir all together, and stuff the pheasant with this mixture.
Sew up, and truss.
Have ready boiling hot olive oil or goma-seed oil, pour it over the pheasant, and place in a hot oven.
Roast until tender (about one hour), adding little by little the rest of the cooking sauce, and basting frequently.
Cook for a half-hour longer, then place on hot platter and garnish with flower petals and water cress.

title: Mushi Kujira (Boiled Whale or Bass)
description: Prepared with fish, orange, and radishes.
steps: Take off all bones and slice the fish daintily in long slices, and then in half-inch dice.
Sprinkle with salt, and leave for about fifteen minutes.
Cut radishes in long, even, delicate strips.
Boil for a few minutes, strain, then add half a cupful of syou sauce and two tablespoonfuls of a fine vinegar.
When it boils, drop in the fish slices.
Boil up, then push to back of range, and, covered tight, let it simmer for half an hour.
Grate the peels of half a lemon and half an orange, and sprinkle over the fish, after having removed it to a hot platter.
Serve with boiled rice.

title: Mushi Tamana and Buta (Cabbage and Pork)
description: Prepared with cabbage, sauce, and salt pork.
steps: First boil the salt pork for one hour, then chop it in small pieces
Select a good hard cabbage without blemishes and wash it thoroughly in cold water
Soak it in water with a handful of salt to kill all possible vermin
Remove from salted water, and rinse in fresh water, removing all salt
Carefully cut out the heart and center leaves, making a good-sized pocket, and fill this space with the chopped pork and one onion chopped very fine, salt, pepper, and a teaspoonful of goma seeds
Press the cabbage leaves back into place, and tie tight in cheesecloth
Have ready a deep pot of boiling salted water, and in this place the cabbage in the bag
Cover, and boil slowly for two hours
Remove to a platter, and pour over it the syou sauce, which has first been boiled
Serve with rice

title: Nasubi Yaki (Fried Eggplant)
description: Prepared with eggplant, ice, and sauce.

Cover with ice water and a handful of salt
Put on a heavy weight, iron or stone, to press out the juice, and leave for about half an hour
Strain off all water, which will be a dark brown, and rinse with fresh cold water, wiping dry each slice
Dip each piece in beaten eggs, and fry in goma-seed oil
Drain off all oil
Place on a platter, covering well with one cupful of cooking sauce, boiled
Sprinkle with goma seeds, and serve with rice

title: Ringo-Kan (Apple Jelly, Japanese Style)
description: Prepared with jelly, apples, and starch.
steps: Wash half a pound of seaweed jelly and soak it in water for about three hours, then squeeze it dry and break in small pieces into a pan with one and a half quarts of water.
Boil over medium heat.
Add three quarters of a pound of sugar, stirring the while, and a pinch of salt.
Prepare two big, tart apples by peeling and removing the cores, then rub them on a nutmeg grater until they are reduced to powder.
Transfer jelly to another saucepan, strain it, and mix with powdered apple.

title: Roast Squab
description: Prepared with squab, chicken, and mushrooms.
steps: Clean and singe a plump squab.
Rub inside and out with salt.
Stuff it with the following: A dozen mushrooms, peeled and cut small, a tablespoonful of almonds which have been blanched and chopped fine, and a little minced onion.
Mix together, and fill the squab.
Now sew or skew tight, and melt the tablespoonful of chicken fat and pour it over the squab.
Place in a hot oven and roast for half an hour, basting and turning frequently.
Make the gravy, meanwhile, by chopping fine two chicken livers and frying them in a teaspoonful of chicken fat.
When very brown, stir in a teaspoonful of cornstarch until brown.
Now add two tablespoonfuls of syou, and serve with the squab.

title: Sakura (Cherry Custard)
description: Prepared with cherry, cherries, and eggs.
steps: Beat up lightly and frothily six fresh eggs
Add one cupful of milk, sugar, and three tablespoonfuls of cherry sirup
Throw a handful of ripe, plump red cherries into the baking pan, and over this pour the above mixture
Bake for about half an hour in a medium oven
Remove, and at intervals over top of dish set more cherries

title: Seaweed Soup
description: A soup made with chicken, vinegar, and eggs.

ingredients.name: one and one half teaspoonfuls of Quong Sang Chong (water chestnut flour)
ingredients.sourceText: one and one half teaspoonfuls of Quong Sang Chong (water chestnut flour)

steps: Boil one can of seaweed until it is like thin jelly
Have ready three chicken giblets, chopped very fine, having first boiled them one hour in a quart of water
Add the seaweed, and boil all together for half an hour
Strain, then crumble in the yolks of two hard-boiled eggs
Stir in two tablespoonfuls of syou, and salt to taste
Rub smooth one and a half teaspoonfuls of Quong Sang Chong in a little cold water, then add to the soup and stir until it thickens slightly
Serve with a small piece of seaweed on top that has been soaking in spiced vinegar

title: Shika Shiro (Pot-roasted Venison)
description: Prepared with venison, sauce, and vinegar.

ingredients.name: one quarter pound of fresh pork (fat)
ingredients.sourceText: one quarter pound of fresh pork (fat)

ingredients.name: one quarter pound of miso paste
ingredients.sourceText: one quarter pound of miso paste

steps: Place the meat in an earthenware bowl and cover with one cup of vinegar, two tablespoonfuls of sugar and the same amount of salt, one tablespoonful of mixed spices, and one onion, sliced.
Cover, and put away to pickle for two or three days in a cool place.
When ready to cook, remove meat from the juices, cut up the pork in small strips, and fry a light brown in deep iron pan.
Add the venison meat, and fry well on both sides until brown, taking care not to burn it.
Add the syou sauce, cover tight, and let simmer for one hour, or two, if necessary.
Mix the miso paste with a little cold water, and stir it until it thickens.
Remove the platter, and garnish with slices of lemon sprinkled with chopped parsley.

title: Shu Bok Ap (Fried Squab)
description: Prepared with squabs, olive or peanut or oil, and chicken.

ingredients.name: One quarter pound of white mushrooms
ingredients.sourceText: One quarter pound of white mushrooms

steps: Cut the squabs in pieces, not too small, Let the legs be separated from the body, also the wings, and cut the rest in four pieces.
Singe off all hair and feathers.
Wash in cold water, and wipe dry.
Dip each piece of squab in dry flour, and toss in boiling olive or peanut oil.
Cook until it is crisp.

Drain off all fat, while preparing the following: Put one tablespoonful of olive oil in the pan, and when it is hot, place the chicken livers (chopped very fine) in the fat, add a small minced onion, two tablespoonfuls of syou, a tablespoonful of Chinese small almonds, blanched and chopped, and a quarter of a pound of white mushrooms, cut small.
Fry for ten minutes, then pour into hot dish and place the squab on top, garnished with crumbled hard-boiled yolks of eggs.

description: Prepared with duck, pork, and mushrooms.

ingredients.name: Three and one half pound duck
ingredients.sourceText: Three and one half pound duck

ingredients.name: One quarter pound of water chestnuts

ingredients.name: One and one half tablespoonfuls of syou

steps: After the duck has been well cleaned, inside and out, cut down the breast, dry well, and rub it thoroughly with salt.
Lay in a bowl, and then prepare the following filling: Take one quarter pound of pork, chopped fine; one quarter pound of mushrooms, cut small, and one quarter pound of water chestnuts, sliced thin.
Boil one quarter pound of barley for ten minutes, adding half a tablespoonful of syou and a teaspoonful of salt.
Mix together all of the above ingredients, fill the duck, and sew or skew it up.
Steam for three hours, and serve with rice.

title: Sweet and Pungent Chicken
description: Prepared with chicken, vinegar, and onion.

ingredients.name: Three and one half pound chicken
ingredients.sourceText: Three and one half pound chicken

steps: Take a young chicken of about three and one half pounds.
Clean and singe it, and remove all the bones.
Lay in a stone dish and over it pour (enough to cover well) a mixture of two cupfuls of boiling vinegar, a dessert-spoonful of salt, and two tablespoonfuls of sugar.
Cover, and put away in a cool place for twenty-four hours.
Prepare a brown gravy by chopping half an onion and frying it a light brown in sweet lard or chicken fat.
Cut the chicken into quarters, and put in a pan with two tablespoonfuls of syou.
Simmer for half an hour very gently.
Serve with rice.

title: Tamago Bolan (Peony Eggs)
description: Prepared with eggs, fish, and lettuce.
steps: Boil five eggs hard
Place in cold water
Remove shells carefully, so as not to blemish whites
Carefully cut off top with thread, one end between teeth, the other between fingers, drawing thread through egg
Remove the yolks
Boil a small pink snapper (fish) in hot water for ten minutes, or steam for thirty
Remove all bones and fins, and chop together until fine
Mix with finely mashed miso, pepper, and salt
Chop yolks daintily and fluffily, and mix with fish meat
Fill the whites with this mixture
Place the filled whites in center of a lettuce head and arrange fine strips of udo shoots round it
Carefully adjust and separate all the leaves of the lettuce head, wash, and then put back into shape again
Hold together with toothpicks

title: Tembani of Mackerel (Fish Delicacy)
description: Prepared with mackerel, radish, and sauce.

ingredients.name: one half cupful of cooking juice
ingredients.sourceText: one half cupful of cooking juice

steps: Clean the fish, and remove all bones.
Cut into half-inch dice, sprinkle with salt, and let stand for about half an hour.
Wash the radish and cut into thin pieces, then throw it into the salted, boiling water.
Boil for about five minutes, then strain off all water and add half a cupful of syou sauce and the same amount of cooking juice.
Let all boil up, then add the fish and let it simmer for about twenty-five minutes.
Remove from the fire, and before serving add a tablespoonful of vinegar.
Place on a hot platter, and sprinkle with grated lemon or orange peel.
Serve with boiled rice.

title: To Boil Rice
description: Prepared with rice, water, and salt.

ingredients.name: one and one quarter cupfuls of cold water
ingredients.sourceText: one and one quarter cupfuls of cold water

steps: Wash the rice thoroughly in many waters, until the water is as clear as for drinking
To one cupful of rice add one and one quarter cupfuls of cold water
Cover tight, and boil slowly half an hour—no more
On no account stir
Set on back of range, covered with a clean cloth or napkin, until ready to serve
Rice should be served in individual bowls, replenished as soon as empty throughout the meal
Salt is not added until it is served

title: Tori Shiru (Chicken Soup)
description: A soup made with chicken, sauce, and mushrooms.

ingredients.name: one half pound of egg noodles
ingredients.sourceText: one half pound of egg noodles

ingredients.name: one quarter pound of white mushrooms
ingredients.sourceText: one quarter pound of white mushrooms

steps: Thoroughly clean and singe the chicken, and scald feet to peel off scabs or skin.
Cut giblets in small pieces and the chicken in about six pieces, and cover with three quarts of cold water.
Boil all for about three hours, according to the age of the chicken.
While it is boiling wash and cut up the vegetables.
Now make the egg noodles of flour and eggs and roll as thin as paper on a floured board, then cut in shapes of flowers (chrysanthemums, the Japanese prefer), and leave spread out on the board to dry.
Drain all soup from the bones and bring to a boil.
Add vegetables, salt, pepper, and one teaspoonful of sugar; also the syou sauce.
Boil all for half an hour, then throw in the noodles and cook for ten minutes.
Serve each bowl of soup with one large noodle flower on top.

title: Tori-Kan (Chicken Jelly)
description: Prepared with chicken, jelly or gelatine, and mushrooms.

ingredients.name: one half pound seaweed jelly or gelatine
ingredients.sourceText: one half pound seaweed jelly or gelatine

steps: Cook in boiling water a young, tender chicken until it is tender.
Take from the liquid, remove all the bone and cut in small pieces.
Pick off stalks from mushrooms and soak in lukewarm water for twenty minutes.
Cut in small pieces and boil for twenty-five minutes in about two cupfuls of water.
Add the mirin sauce and boil again about five minutes.
Wash the dry seaweed jelly and soak for about two hours, then take from water and squeeze dry.
Break into small pieces and boil in one quart of water until it dissolves.
Strain into another saucepan, with a pinch of salt and a tablespoonful of sugar.
To this add the mushrooms and mirin sauce, and mix all together, with the chicken meat, salt, pepper, spices, etc.
Have ready a lacquered box or smooth wooden box or mold, and pour in the mixture.
Let it set, and, when serving, cut it in slices.

title: Unohana Yaki (Flower Custard)
description: Prepared with gelatine, cherry, and seeds.
steps: To make the pink custards, whip the whites of five eggs into the dissolved two ounces of gelatine.
Add, while stirring over a slow fire, three tablespoonfuls of cherry sirup.
Let it come to a boil, then pour quickly into flower-shaped molds, and let it set.
Yellow custards can be made by using the yolks instead of the whites of eggs, and half a pint of coconut milk.
When the custards are solid, turn them from the molds on to large leaves on a plate, or decorate the flowered custard with leaves suitable to the flower represented.
If the flower has a dark center, use goma seeds, and if variegated colors are liked, pour half the yellow and half the cherry custards into the molds.
The pouring should be done very quickly and lightly, and the molds, of course, should be of flower designs.

title: Usagi Amai-Sui (Hare, Sweet and Sour)
description: Prepared with rabbit or hare, vinegar, and sauce.

ingredients.name: one half cupful of mirin sauce
ingredients.sourceText: one half cupful of mirin sauce

ingredients.name: one half pound of fat fresh pork
ingredients.sourceText: one half pound of fat fresh pork

steps: Take a small hare or large rabbit that has been hanging for at least two days, and after it has been skinned, and the insides removed, wash well in cold water.
Cut in quarters and put in a deep dish, covering it well with the vinegar, sugar, salt, and so on, mixed with water.
Add the spices also, and a quarter of a cupful of mirin sauce.
Cover up well, and let it pickle in a cool place for two or three days.
Remove it from the liquid and cut in small pieces.
Have ready the fat pork cut in small pieces, and fry.
Toss in the hare, and brown.
Have ready a covered China cook dish or casserole, and place in it the hare and pork, adding the syou sauce, a pinch of salt, pinch of the spices, and the quarter cupful of mirin sauce.
Cover up tightly, and cook in a slow oven for one hour.
Then prepare a dozen large red plums, removing the stones, and add them.
Dissolve one teaspoonful of Kanton and mix with the gravy, taking care not to break the plums.
Cook for another five minutes, then place on a hot platter, decorated with slices of lemon or limes, with a plum placed on top of each slice.
This is good served either with white-bean cakes or rice.

steps: Peel and wash these little nuts, which are about the size of an ordinary chestnut.

Mix all until smooth, then pour it over the water chestnuts.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley.

title: Yaki Udzura (Broiled Quail or Pigeons)
description: Prepared with quail or pigeons, mushrooms, and cheese.
steps: Prepare the quail or pigeons the day before using by washing and singeing and rubbing with salt, then put them away in cool place.
Next day take half a pound of aburage, and fry the Tofu cakes in oil.
Set in warm place to drain off the oil while toasting the birds.
Dip the birds in olive oil, then in dry flour, and toast over a red-hot fire, turning quickly until they are a crisp brown.
Place each bird, or half of a bird, if it is a pigeon, on the fried Tofu, and have some white mushrooms which have been fried in oil, placed around the birds.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley, and serve very hot.

Pound the fish to a powder, and mix one cup of the fish with a quarter pound of blanched almonds, also pounded

Beat the whites of two eggs with a little cold water, enough to make a thin paste

Roll very thin, cut into cakes, and bake in a hot oven in hot peanut oil for twenty minutes
Remove the cakes from the oil, and drain on paper in a slow oven until cakes are dry and crisp

Let it stew till the apples are quite soft
Chop 1/4 lb of suet very fine, put it in a dish with 6 oz. of flour, a little salt, mix with a little cold water
Make it into a paste, roll it out on your paste-board 3 times
Divide it in 4 pieces, grease a pudding basin well, and put in a little brown sugar with a little cinnamon
Roll out one of the pieces of dough, put it at the bottom of the basin
Put a layer of the stewed fruit, so on alternately, leaving the last layer of paste to form the top
Bake it, and turn it out of the basin to send it to table

title: A Brown Fricassee
description: Prepared with breast of veal, beef gravy, and white pepper.

ingredients.name: half a glass of white wine or a table-spoonful of walnut liquor
ingredients.sourceText: half a glass of white wine or a table-spoonful of walnut liquor

steps: Cut the breast of veal in pieces and fry them lightly
Put them into a stewpan with a good beef gravy, seasoned with white pepper, salt, a couple of sliced onions previously browned in a little oil, and a piece of whole ginger
Let it simmer very slowly for two hours taking care to remove the scum or fat
Spread rich forcemeat about an inch thick over three cold hard boiled eggs
Fry these for a few moments and put them in the saucepan with the veal
Before serving, cut these balls in quarters, and render the gravy more savory by the addition of lemon juice and half a glass of white wine, or a table-spoonful of walnut liquor
If the gravy is not sufficiently thick by long stewing, stir in a little browned flour

title: A Delicious Cream Cheese
description: Prepared with cheese, milk, and butter.
steps: Allow sweet milk to stand until it is like a jelly, but does not separate.
Pour it into a cheese-cloth bag and hang up to drain until all the water is out of it and only the rich creamy substance remains.
When all the water is out, turn the cheese from the bag into a bowl.
To every pint of the cheesy substance add a tablespoon of butter and enough salt to season it palatably.
Whip it up with a fork until it is a smooth paste.
Put enough on a plate to make a little brick, like a Philadelphia cheese.
With two knives, one in each hand, lightly press the cheese together in the shape of a brick.
Smooth it over the top and put it away to cool.

title: A Portugal Cake
description: A cake made with flour, butter, and sugar.
steps: Take half-a-pound of the best flour, put it before the fire to dry for half an hour.
Sift it through a sieve, put it aside.
Melt 1/2 lb. of butter to oil.
Put 3/4 lb. of castor sugar in a skillet or pan that is round at the bottom.
Break over the sugar 9 fresh eggs.
Stir the eggs and sugar till it froths.
Put in the butter by degrees while another person stirs the eggs and sugar.
When the butter is well worked in, then put the flour in the same way by spoonfuls.
When it is well worked in, grease your tin and sift a little fine sugar in the tin.
Put it in a slow oven.

ingredients.name: a tea-cup full of button onions or a Spanish onion
ingredients.sourceText: a tea-cup full of button onions or a Spanish onion

steps: Put a fine steak in a stewpan with a large piece of clarified suet or fat, and a couple of onions sliced
Let the steak fry for a few minutes, turning it several times
Cover the steak with gravy, or even water will answer the purpose
Add a tea-cup full of button onions or a Spanish onion sliced, a little lemon peel, pepper, salt, and a little allspice
Simmer till the steak is done
Remove the steak and carefully skim the gravy
Add to it a little browning and a spoonful of mushroom ketchup
Keep the steak on a hot stove or return it to the stewpan to warm up
If the gravy is not thick enough, stir in a little flour

title: A Simple Way of Making Beef Tea
description: Prepared with gravy, water, and salt.
steps: Cut the gravy beef in pieces the size of dice, put into a pint of water with a very little salt, 2 cloves, 2 allspice
Let it boil for 1 hour only
Toast a small piece of crust
Let it boil with the crust to colour it
Strain it through a very clean sieve into a white basin

title: A Simple White Soup
description: A soup made with veal, chorissa, and carrot.

ingredients.name: two or three quarts of water or weak broth
ingredients.sourceText: two or three quarts of water or weak broth

steps: Break a knuckle of veal and place it in a stewpan
Also place a piece of chorissa, a carrot, two onions, three or four turnips, and a blade of mace
Pour over two or three quarts of water or weak broth
Season with salt, a sprig of parsley, and whole white pepper
When sufficiently boiled, skim and strain it
Thicken with pounded vermicelli

title: A Slice of Salmon with Montpelier Butter
description: Prepared with salmon, butter, and anchovies.
steps: Put 8 anchovies well washed and boned in a mortar with 1/4 lb. of fresh butter
Put into boiling water 2 shalots, 1 tooth of garlic, a little tarragon, a little fennel
Take them out and dip them in cold water
When quite cold put them in the mortar with the rest
Add to them the yolks of 4 eggs boiled hard, with salt and a little cayenne
Pound it all well and rub it through a sieve
Put it over the slice of cold salmon

title: A Soda Cake
description: A cake made with fruit, flour, and eggs.
steps: Mix with the common cake ingredients one drachm of soda, which should be rubbed in with the flour
This is reckoned a wholesome cake, and half the quantity of eggs are required
It may be rendered a fine rich cake by increasing the quantity of eggs, butter, and fruit

title: A Souffle
description: Prepared with cream, rice or flour, and milk.

ingredients.name: half a pint of new milk
ingredients.sourceText: half a pint of new milk

ingredients.name: rice-flour or potatoe-flour
ingredients.sourceText: four ounces of rice-flour or potatoe-flour

ingredients.name: two to three ounces of fresh butter
ingredients.sourceText: two to three ounces of fresh butter

ingredients.name: yolks of six to eight eggs
ingredients.sourceText: yolks of six to eight eggs

ingredients.name: whites of six to eight eggs
ingredients.sourceText: whites of six to eight eggs

steps: Warm the cream and milk together in a clean saucepan
Make a smooth batter with rice-flour or potatoe-flour
Stir the batter into the milk
Let it simmer, stirring all the time till it thickens
Add fresh butter and white sifted sugar enough to sweeten
Add grated lemon peel
Take it off the fire and stir quickly the well-beaten yolks of six to eight eggs
Butter the pan and pour the mixture into it
When on the point of being placed into the oven, add the whites of the eggs thoroughly whisked
Fill the pan only half full, as it will rise very high
Bake in the oven
Serve immediately it is taken from the oven, holding a salamander over it to prevent its falling
